camel_example: aliyun paiflow GET /api/v1/pipelines --region cn-hangzhou --FuzzyMatching false --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --PipelineIdentifier SqlWriteTable_2 --WorkspaceId 72600 --PipelineProvider pai --PipelineVersion v1 --header "Content-Type=application/json"
kebab_example: aliyun paiflow list-pipelines --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --pipeline-identifier SqlWriteTable_2 --pipeline-provider pai --pipeline-version v1 --workspace-id 72600 --fuzzy-matching false --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPipelines

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 工作流列表的页码。起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的工作流数量
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The pipeline identifier. You can call ListPipelines to obtain the identifier
parameters.help_zh: 需要过滤的工作流标识。您可以在ListPipelines查询结果中获取Identifier
parameters.name: pipeline_identifier

parameters.help_en:
The pipeline provider.

The value is pai if the pipeline is provided by PAI.
The value is the ID of the Alibaba Cloud account if the pipeline is created by using the account
parameters.help_zh:
需要过滤的工作流提供者。
PAI官方提供的工作流，Provider为pai。
您创建的工作流，该值为您的阿里云账号ID
parameters.name: pipeline_provider

parameters.help_zh: 需要过滤的工作流版本
parameters.name: pipeline_version

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html to obtain the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: 需要过滤的工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to support fuzzy match. Valid values:

false
true
parameters.help_zh:
是否支持模糊匹配。取值如下：
false：不支持
true：支持
parameters.name: fuzzy_matching

GmtCreateTime.description_en: The time when the pipeline was created, in UTC. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard

GmtModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the pipeline was modified, in UTC. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard

Provider.description_en:
The pipeline provider.

The value is pai if the pipeline is provided by PAI.
The value is the ID of the Alibaba Cloud account if the pipeline is created by using the account
Provider.description_zh:
工作流提供者。
PAI平台提供的工作流Provider为pai。
您创建的工作流，该值为您的阿里云账号ID

Uuid.description_en: The UUID of the pipeline. A UUID is generated each time the user modifies the pipeline
Uuid.description_zh: 工作流当前版本标识，用户每次更新，会生成该uuid
